name: Password Sign-In Succeeds
summary: The user submits valid password credentials, the server authenticates the durable identity, establishes a normal session, and returns the resolved landing destination.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the submitted credentials identify an active password-enabled durable identity

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password supplied through the test runner's secure settings.

serverInteraction.intent: Authenticate the identified durable identity with the submitted password, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and the resolved application landing destination is active

sourceReferences.note: PasswordSignInAsync completes successful authentication through CompleteSignInToAppAsync and records PasswordAuthenticationSucceeded.
SuccessfulLogin_Should_ReturnAuthenticated_And_RecordStartedThenSucceeded proves the successful server path and event trail.
Presentation review keeps successful sign-in host-directed: the server returns the resolved landing destination and the auth model does not invent an extra success confirmation surface.
